svg.text: Keep clear space around the logo equal to half the width of the icon tile.
Minimum size: full logo 96 px wide, icon alone 16 px.
Under 96 px wide, use the icon on its own (favicon, avatar, app icon).
– Stretch, rotate or skew the logo.
– Recolour it. Use the one-colour version instead.
– Add shadows, outlines or other effects.
– Place it on busy or low-contrast backgrounds.
